from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitation(BaseModel):
    """Citation relationship extracted from a single provided paper document."""
    source_paper_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the paper currently being processed")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] | None = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list or bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated extraction results from the provided documents."""
    papers: list[PaperCitation]
